messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Avoid eating foods high in fat or cholesterol, or atorvastatin will not be as effective.
Drinking alcohol may increase your risk of liver damage.
Grapefruit may interact with atorvastatin and cause side effects. Avoid consuming grapefruit products and drinking more than 1.2 liters of grapefruit juice each day.
Triplet: ["atorvastatin", "may increase risk of", "liver damage when alcohol is consumed"]

The relation 'may increase risk of' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug may elevate the risk of the adverse health condition specified by the object entity when combined with the specified substance or activity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
B. 'has warning': The subject drug carries a safety warning or precaution about the risk or situation specified by the object entity.
C. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
D. 'interacts with': The subject drug has a drug interaction with the drug or substance specified by the object entity that may change effects or cause harm.
E. 'increases risk of': Taking the subject drug may raise the patient's likelihood of experiencing the condition or event specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
